scope: Original zero-coordinate utterance and three explicit-coordinate variations; development counterexamples, not a held-out NLP benchmark.

results.input: Explain why absolute value is not differentiable at zero
results.reply: abs(x) is not differentiable at zero: its left-hand slope is -1 and its right-hand slope is 1, so no single tangent slope exists.
results.note: Independent abs(x) rule: derivative is +1 for x>0, -1 for x<0, undefined at zero. Coordinate agreement is a necessary check, not a complete explanation oracle.

results.input: Explain why absolute value is not differentiable at x = 2
results.reply: abs(x) is differentiable at x=2.0: both one-sided slopes are 1.0, so its derivative is 1.0.
results.note: Independent abs(x) rule: derivative is +1 for x>0, -1 for x<0, undefined at zero. Coordinate agreement is a necessary check, not a complete explanation oracle.
